title: fourraea alpina
intro: Fourraea alpina, commonly known as the Alpina gentian, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of Asia. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Fourraea alpina include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and act as an antioxidant, while its therapeutic actions include its analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Fourraea alpina include gentiopicrin, gentiogenin, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
